content:
The correct answer is A. integrated.

Integrated project delivery (IPD) is a type of project delivery that is concerned with all aspects of building performance, including coordination of the different building systems to avoid rework. IPD brings together the key project stakeholders, such as the owner, architect, and construction team, early in the design process to collaborate and ensure the building systems work together effectively.

The other options are not correct:

B. noncompound - This is not a recognized term in construction project delivery methods.

C. sequential - Sequential project delivery is a more traditional approach where the design, construction, and other project phases occur in a linear sequence, rather than the integrated and collaborative approach of IPD.
